composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108-114d "BILGE SYSTEM") serves the bilge pumping/valve equipment of the vessel: the MAIN BILGE PUMP (520-main-bilge-pump), the five engine-room bilge distribution valves (520-bilge-valves), and the MAIN PANEL / ONYX monitoring interfaces (641-vessel-control-panel and 652-onyx-monitoring) that display/command these. Evidence: title block reads "BILGE SYSTEM"; the pump symbol is explicitly labelled MAIN BILGE PUMP; the five identical valve/motor groups are each labelled "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE" and feed named zones (PORT/STBD LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG. ROOM, FWD, SAIL LOCKER); MAIN PANEL PLUG C/D and the MAIN PANEL PC CARD carry the S13/S20-S24 switches and open/closed lamp indicators; a stub explicitly labelled "to ONYX" ties the Re6 loop off-sheet to ONYX monitoring.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Pump motor symbol explicitly labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' top-right; supplied via F3 60A/SW8/SO 6 and via S13 on the MAIN PANEL. Engineer has closed identity: main bilge pump is a Gianneschi ACB 431B, separate physical unit from the fire pump of same model.

functions.label: Main bilge pump run/stop control
functions.what_it_does: Runs the main bilge pump motor to discharge bilge water; can be started from three alternative points converging on the same coil circuit (local switch, main panel switch, or ONYX remote), consistent with the engineer's confirmed multi-switch activation topology for this pump.

flow_scenarios.path: F3 60A fuse -> SW8 breaker -> SO 6 (fuse-like element) -> T/S S terminal 13/14 -> pump motor circuit idle until a switch closes the loop
LOCAL PUMP SW (contact 1, T/S S terminal 13) closes the loop -> pump energised, + from F3/SW8/SO6 supply chain, - returns via ground/earth symbol on the motor
S13 (BILGE PUMP SW on MAIN PANEL bus) -> MAIN BILGE PUMP output -> also reports back via lamp_S13/status lamp tap to PLUG C pin 6 and onward to MAIN PANEL PC CARD

flow_scenarios.state: ONYX remote command (engineer-confirmed pattern from GM-114a)
flow_scenarios.path: XA11 pin 32 tap -> Re6 coil -> closes contact feeding pump start circuit; 'to ONYX' stub is the cross-reference/return path for this remote command

functions.dry_data: 24V DC motor, ground-referenced return; F3 60A upstream fuse; SO 6 fuse-like element on T/S S; XA11 pin 32 tags the ONYX remote command
functions.sheet_region: top-left supply chain (F3/SW8/SO6/T/S S) + top-right pump symbol + MAIN PANEL S13/PLUG C/D region

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bilge Valves — Engine Room Bilge Distribution (5x, Burkert electric rotary actuators)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Five identical motorised valve groups, each labelled 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE', fed from breaker Q13 10A ('BILGE VALVES') through relays Re1-Re5 and terminal strip T/S C, each valve routing suction from one named zone (Port/Stbd Lazarette combined at valve 1, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker).

functions.label: Open/Close control of each zone's bilge suction valve
functions.what_it_does: Each of the five valve motors opens or closes its zone's bilge suction line into the main bilge system, commanded by an OPEN/CLOSE contact pair wired through relays Re1-Re5, with position status (open/closed) reported to the MAIN PANEL PC CARD lamp bank.

flow_scenarios.path: BILGE VALVES breaker Q13 10A -> T/S B terminals 8-13 (common feed bus, net25/net38) -> relays Re1(valve1)/Re2(valve2)/Re3(valve3)/Re4(valve4)/Re5(valve5) -> T/S C terminal blocks -> valve motor [2]/[3] terminals
OPEN contact (NO, per measured contact state) closes -> relay energised -> valve motor drives open -> status lamp 'open' at MAIN PANEL PC CARD lights via +24V diode network

CLOSE contact (NC, per measured contact state) -> relay de-energised state holds valve closed by default; commanding CLOSE removes hold or drives closed side -> status lamp 'closed' lights at MAIN PANEL PC CARD
Port/Stbd Lazarette Bilge switches feed valve 1 (Re1) suction into the engine room bilge main
Aft Bilge switch feeds valve 2 (Re2) suction into the engine room bilge main
Eng. Room Bilge switch feeds valve 3 (Re3) suction into the engine room bilge main
Fwd Bilge switch feeds valve 4 (Re4) suction into the engine room bilge main
Sail Locker switch feeds valve 5 (Re5) suction into the engine room bilge main

key_components: relays Re1, Re2, Re3, Re4, Re5
OPEN/CLOSE contact pairs (measured NO/NC per contact)
terminal strip T/S B (feed) and T/S C (distribution, 50 terminals)
bilge-position status lamps (open/closed) on MAIN PANEL PC CARD
functions.dry_data: Burkert electric rotary actuators on Burkert 2-way DN050 ball valves ×5 (per BOM 016/017 established fact); supply Q13 10A; each valve motor terminals labelled [2]/[3] on T/S C

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Main Panel / Vessel Control Panel — Bilge System interface
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: MAIN PANEL PLUG C, PLUG D, and MAIN PANEL PC CARD form the panel-side switch bank (S13, S20-S24) and lamp bank (open/closed indicators, pedestal alarm+mute) that command and display the bilge pump and valves; per engineer mapping MAIN PANEL -> 641-vessel-control-panel.

functions.label: Bilge system switch bank and status display
functions.what_it_does: Provides the operator switches (S13 bilge pump, S20 Lazarette, S21 Aft, S22 Eng.Room, S23 Fwd, S24 Sail Locker bilge valves) and open/closed position lamps for each valve, plus a pedestal alarm+mute module, aggregating bilge system status for the crew.

flow_scenarios.path: MAIN PANEL bus -> S13/S20/S21/S22/S23/S24 -> respective PLUG C pins -> out to the bilge pump/valve relay coils via T/S C and T/S B
MAIN PANEL PC CARD receives open/closed diode-gated status per valve from PLUG D pins 1-10, +24V bus via diode network, illuminating one lamp per zone per state
PEDESTAL ALARM + MUTE module ties to PLUG C pins 8-12 and AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD [1]-[4]; a remote mute switch can silence the alarm

key_components: switches S13, S20, S21, S22, S23, S24
MAIN PANEL PC CARD diode network + lamp bank
functions.dry_data: 24V DC status/lamp network gated by diodes per zone; PLUG C/D are 12-pin multi-way connectors linking panel to the T/S C/T/S B terminal strips

equipment_groups.equipment_name: ONYX Monitoring & Control — bilge system tie-in
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Explicit stub labelled 'to ONYX' from the Re6 relay area, plus XA10/XA11/XA40 tags identified in the netlist as STATUS taps (no coil on their nets) except the Re6-related XA11:32 which reaches a relay coil per the loop walk and is treated as command per the coil-reaching rule.

functions.label: Bilge pump/valve status and remote command reporting to ONYX
functions.what_it_does: Reports bilge pump and valve open/closed states to the ONYX monitoring system via XA10/XA40 status taps, and provides an ONYX-side remote start capability for the main bilge pump via XA11 pin 32 into relay Re6 (per engineer-confirmed multi-switch activation pattern established on this same GM-114a sheet).

flow_scenarios.path: XA40 (pins 12/14/16) and XA10 (pins 02/04/06) tap off valve/relay contact nets -> to ONYX, no coil on these nets, confirming STATUS OUT direction per measured tag verdict
XA11 pin 32 -> Re6 coil -> closes bilge pump start path (as detailed under Main Bilge Pump); 'to ONYX' stub is this loop's cross-reference back to the ONYX drawing

key_components: XA11 command tap (32) on relay Re6
functions.dry_data: Tag verdicts measured: XA40 (net818) and XA10 (net1205) = STATUS, no coil on net

infrastructure.system_name: 24V DC Service Battery Supply & Distribution (this sheet)
facts: Fed from +24V SERVICE BAT. via F2 200A main fuse (bottom-left) feeding the whole sheet's bus
F3 60A and SW8 breaker feed the local pump switch/SO6 chain for the main bilge pump
Q13 10A breaker labelled BILGE VALVES feeds T/S B terminals 8-13 which distribute to relays Re1-Re5
T/S S, T/S B, T/S C are terminal strips forming the distribution backbone of this sheet; terminal 13 on T/S S carries a built-in fuse-like element (troubleshooting culprit)

cross_references.what: to ONYX stub (Re6 loop) and XA10/XA11/XA40 status/command taps

F2 200A main fuse rating on service battery feed — value visible on drawing
Q13 10A breaker rating for BILGE VALVES — value visible on drawing
Exact wire-gauge diamond callouts (D-symbols) near ENG. ROOM BILGE SW and other switch lines — read at inspection if needed

uncertainties: Correspondence between the five valve/relay groups (Re1-Re5) and their exact zone assignment is only partially established: net-level measurement confirms Re1 pairs with a switch/T/S C group but the specific zone name (Port/Stbd Lazarette vs valve1) is read from proximity/labels on the raster image rather than being explicitly bound in the measured netlist for every valve; treat the valve-to-zone mapping as sheet-drawn label association, not netlist-confirmed for all five.

Re6 contact state is flagged as a CONFLICT in the measured contact-state data (symbol read as NC but wiring shows NO) — the true NO/NC state of Re6, and therefore whether ONYX/XA11 energising it OPENS or CLOSES the pump start path, cannot be stated with certainty from this sheet alone.

The positive/feed side of each of the five bilge zone position switches (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng.Room, Fwd, Sail Locker BILGE SW) is not traced on this sheet — only the negative/return tap to the valve motor is shown; these are incomplete on the feed side per the loop-walk data.

S13's PLUG C pin7 -> common bus onward path and the exact relay identity behind the 'relay contact/coil group below (Re...)' partially-illegible labels (Re9, Re10, Re11 in early extraction, later corrected in netlist to Re1-Re6) could not be fully disambiguated; only Re1-Re6 are confirmed as real relays on this sheet per the RELAYS block.
